ProjectWeave request for the selected Task (data):
{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVRkquM8AAAABZhBuLg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5zhDID1s", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn_T5", "number": 61, "title": "Implement static Mode 7 EXTBG decoding and composition", "body": "## Problem

Mode 7 cannot render EXTBG's BG2. At baseline `3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0`, `bg_pixel` assigns BG2 zero depth and returns only BG1 for Mode 7. `mode7` always emits layer 0 at one priority. Consequently, enabling `$2133.6` cannot produce BG2 pixels or their screen, window, priority and color-math effects. See [BG dispatch](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/crates/snes-core/src/ppu.rs#L465) and [Mode 7 sampling](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/crates/snes-core/src/ppu.rs#L538).

BG1 direct color also needs reconciliation: the implementation suppresses it whenever EXTBG is enabled, and an [existing test](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/crates/snes-core/tests/direct_color.rs#L209) requires the paletted result. [Issue #59's validation](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/docs/issue-59-validation.md#remaining-uncertainty-and-inventory) explicitly says that assertion does not settle the hardware question.

## Expected outcome

Implement static, non-mosaic, non-interlaced, 256-pixel Mode 7 EXTBG through the existing renderer, including BG2 decoding and composition. Resolve BG1 direct-color behavior from specifications rather than preserving the old assertion merely because it passes.

### Specification contract and prerequisite

Consult [Anomie's Register Doc](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gilligan/snesdev/master/docs/snes_registers.txt), sections `$2105`, `$2123–$2133`, Mode 7 and background priority, and [Fullsnes](https://problemkaputt.de/fullsnes.htm), sections Mode 7/EXTBG, BG priority, Direct Color Mode, windows and color math. The repository records Anomie revision 1157 (2007-07-12), a Fullsnes no$sns v1.5 extraction, and their hashes in [Issue #59's specification record](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/docs/issue-59-validation.md#specification-contract-recorded-before-test-expectations).

These external texts were not retrieved during this repository-only planning pass; no local specification copies are present. Before coding, record the exact source sections/version supporting or correcting this proposed contract:

- In BGMODE 7, SETINI bit 6 enables BG2. BG1 and BG2 use the same Mode 7 map, character byte and transformed position; BG2 does not introduce a separate planar map or scroll transform.
- BG1 retains the full eight-bit pixel value and raw-zero transparency. BG2 uses bits 0–6 as its CGRAM index and bit 7 as priority. BG2 index zero is transparent regardless of bit 7; therefore `$80` is opaque for BG1 and transparent for BG2.
- Front-to-back EXTBG ordering is `OBJ3 > OBJ2 > BG2-high > OBJ1 > BG1 > OBJ0 > BG2-low > backdrop`. The existing renderer's ranks are implementation details, not the specification.
- BG2 uses its own TM/TS bit 1, TMW/TSW bit 1, BG2 window controls and CGADSUB bit 1. BG1 retains its separate controls. A visible BG2 pixel must retain BG2 layer identity through composition; BG2 can also supply the subscreen math operand.
- BG2 remains paletted when direct color is selected. **BG1 direct color with EXTBG remains unresolved in the available repository evidence.** Establish whether `$2130.0` still selects BG1 direct color with `$2133.6` set. Cite the decisive text, implement that result, and replace the old test expectation if contradicted. Record any source disagreement and its resolution; another emulator's output or the previous Issue contract alone is insufficient evidence.

Do not claim the disputed direct-color behavior resolved until this prerequisite has source-backed, executable expectations.

## Context and reproduction

HEAD matches the recorded #59 merge. That change implemented independent Mode 7 offsets and their shared latch; it did not implement EXTBG. The supplied open-Issue list is empty, and the latest assessment selects this missing behavior next.

A minimal counterexample initializes an identity Mode 7 scene under forced blank, uses a nonzero character byte, sets `$2133=$40`, enables only BG2 with `$212C=$02`, then renders. Current dispatch produces the backdrop because BG2 is rejected before sampling.

Use independently authored input bytes and literal expected pixels. With distinct CGRAM entries, cover at least:

| Raw byte | BG1 paletted interpretation | BG2 interpretation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$00` | Transparent | Transparent |
| `$01` | Index 1 | Index 1, low priority |
| `$7F` | Index 127 | Index 127, low priority |
| `$80` | Index 128 | Transparent |
| `$81` | Index 129 | Index 1, high priority |
| `$FF` | Index 255 | Index 127, high priority |

### Focused scope and remaining work

Include decoding, priority against all four OBJ priorities, independent screen/window routing, bounded color-math participation, and the specification-backed BG1 direct-color decision. Reuse the existing transform without expanding its accuracy claims.

Non-goals are Mode 7 mosaic, nonidentity arithmetic/truncation corrections, signed-coordinate/screen-over edge corrections, interlace/overscan, pseudo-hires composition, multiplication timing/interference, physical reset retention and pixel-fetch/raster timing. Keep these specific Mode 7 limitations documented after this Issue.

Retain every complete category scope from the supplied inventory and [existing 24-category record](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/docs/issue-59-validation.md#remaining-uncertainty-and-inventory): `cpu`, `bus`, `scheduler`, `dma`, `hdma`, `controllers`, `ppu-bg`, `ppu-offset`, `ppu-hires`, `ppu-mode7`, `ppu-objects`, `ppu-color`, `ppu-ports`, `ppu-display`, `spc`, `ipl`, `dsp-noise`, `dsp-pitch`, `dsp-envelope`, `dsp-echo` and `dsp-timing` remain partial; `dsp-voices` remains implemented_unverified; `ppu-raster` and `pal` remain unimplemented. No category becomes verified through this Issue.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record the reconciled specification contract before deriving test expectations. Explicitly resolve BG1 direct color with EXTBG, correct any unsupported earlier assertion, and distinguish source facts, derived expectations and remaining uncertainty.
- [ ] Implement BG2's independent color/transparency/priority interpretation while sharing the Mode 7 source coordinates. Verify EXTBG-disabled behavior, other BGMODEs, and #59's independent-offset/shared-latch behavior remain correct.
- [ ] Add focused original Rust integration tests, proposed target `ppu_mode7_extbg`, using baseline public APIs. Check every byte in the table, BG1-only/BG2-only/both enabled, both BG2 priorities against all four OBJ priorities, BG2-disabled controls, and distinct backdrop colors. Use literal BGR555/RGBA expectations rather than production sampling, ranking or conversion helpers.
- [ ] Verify independent TM/TS routing and BG1/BG2 window masking, including window boundaries. Verify BG2-selected versus BG1-selected math-enable bits with simple independently calculated fixed-color addition and a BG2 subscreen operand. Keep broad color-window, saturation and halving accuracy outside this bounded evidence.
- [ ] Add discriminating direct-color vectors for the reconciled BG1 rule, with BG2 disabled and enabled for display, and CGRAM mutations that distinguish direct from paletted output. Confirm BG2 remains paletted. Preserve unaffected direct-color coverage.
- [ ] Demonstrate shared BG1/BG2 source positioning with an interior identity scene and a small nonzero Mode 7 offset; unrelated BG2 planar scroll/map settings must not create an independent source. Avoid treating this as general transform verification.
- [ ] Add an original source-built 65C816 guest with original graphics/palette data and explicit MIT provenance in `tests/roms/PROVENANCE.md`. Initialize through executed CPU register/memory writes under forced blank. Native execution must have instruction/frame deadlines, reject STP/errors, and assert completion plus distinguishing literal pixels over stable frames. Hosts must not patch PPU state or inject success results.
- [ ] Load the same generated guest through the ordinary browser ROM picker. Assert distinguishing actual Wasm framebuffer bytes and canvas ImageData, 256×224 geometry and 229376-byte RGBA length, with bounded polling and no browser errors. Include BG2 visibility, a priority/transparency distinction, and the resolved direct-color behavior across the guest scene(s).
- [ ] Run the new public-API integration tests against exact predecessor `3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0` in an isolated checkout. Record behavioral counterexamples for missing BG2 and any confirmed direct-color correction; compilation failures do not count. Record passing results on the implementation.
- [ ] Pass workspace checks and focused regressions:

```sh
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace --locked
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_mode7_extbg
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_mode7_scroll
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test direct_color
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_obj_limits
cargo test --locked -p snes-core --test ppu_pseudo_hires
```

- [ ] Pass the existing source-built hardware and browser gates documented in [README](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/README.md#validate) and [CI](https://github.com/takahirox/snes-rust/blob/3ef31ed5a7ae5e4bd04591a1b1b7cb7822c952f0/.github/workflows/ci.yml), including:

```sh
python3 tools/make-fixture.py .cache/smoke.bin
cmp tests/roms/smoke.bin .cache/smoke.bin
python3 tools/build-test-tools.py --spc
python3 tools/hardware-tests.py --ca65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ca65" --ld65 "$PWD/.cache/tools/cc65/bin/ld65" --spcasm "$PWD/.cache/tools/spcasm/target/release/spcasm"
python3 tools/ppu-test.py --bass "$PWD/.cache/tools/bass-untech/bass/out/bass-untech"
python3 tools/build-cleared-games.py
python3 tools/build-cleared-games.py
npm --prefix web ci
npm --prefix web run build
(cd web && npx playwright install chromium)
npm --prefix web test -- --grep-invert '301 seconds'
```

- [ ] Preserve existing Castle/Memory source pins, licenses, generated hashes, replay inputs, durations, gameplay/audio assertions and negative controls. Mandatory browser coverage must run without skips. Use original or already cleared licensed source-built artifacts; acquire no commercial ROMs or firmware.
- [ ] Update README and validation/provenance records with exact commands, results, baseline failures and specific remaining limitations. No mandatory check may remain failed or unperformed at merge. Limited passing checks establish neither full hardware accuracy nor commercial compatibility and do not complete Issue #3.

## Optional validation

Additional independently derived nonidentity transform cases, clearly separated from the required static EXTBG evidence.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

Planning evidence: repository inspection only; no files changed, suites executed, external specifications retrieved, or agents started.
